hints.alignmentStyle: Isitayela samaphethini wokuqondanisa (esetshenziswa kumakhodi amakhulu e-QR)

hints.bluetoothNote: Qaphela: Ukumataniswa kwe-Bluetooth nge-QR kuqondene ngqo nomthengisi futhi kungase kungasebenzi kuwo wonke amadivayisi
hints.bounceAnimation: Dlala upopayi uye phambili bese ubuyela emuva (ping-pong)
hints.contrastGuard: Qinisekisa ubuncane besilinganiso sokungafani phakathi kwengaphambili nengemuva
hints.crispEdges: Sebenzisa i-pixelated rendering emiphethweni yemojuli ebukhali
hints.customNote: Faka idatha engahluziwe nganoma iyiphi ifomethi. Akukho ukuqinisekiswa noma ukufometha okuzosetshenziswa.
hints.encodingMode: Imodi yombhalo wedatha - Ikhetha ngokuzenzakalelayo imodi esebenza kahle kakhulu
hints.enforceMinQuietZone: Sebenzisa indawo ethule yamamojula angu-4 ukuze uthole ukwethembeka okungcono kokuskena
hints.enterTextContent: Faka okuqukethwe kombhalo ozokufaka kukhodi ye-QR
hints.epcSepaNote: Ikhodi ye-QR ye-European Payment Council yokudluliswa kwekhredithi kwe-SEPA
hints.errorCorrection: Izinga lokulungiswa kwephutha - liphezulu = ukumelana nokulimala okwengeziwe kodwa ikhodi ye-QR enkulu
hints.extraBorder: Amamojula emingcele engeziwe ngale kwendawo ethulile (0-10)
hints.eyeScale: Amaphethini esitholi sesikali ahlobene nosayizi wawo wokuzenzakalelayo (50-150%)
hints.forceHttps: Guqula ama-URL e-HTTP abe yi-HTTPS ngokuzenzakalela
hints.frameStyle: Engeza uhlaka lokuhlobisa eduze kwekhodi ye-QR
hints.gs1Note: I-GS1 Digital Link yokuhlonza umkhiqizo nokulandeleka
hints.higherEccLargerQr: Okuphakeme = ukumelana nokulimala okwengeziwe, i-QR enkulu
hints.maxLengthGuard: Vimbela okuqukethwe kombhalo wekhodi okweqa umthamo wekhodi ye-QR
hints.minContrastRatio: Isilinganiso esincane sokungafani ukuze kusetshenziswe (1-21, i-WCAG AA idinga u-4.5:1)
hints.moduleSize: Usayizi wemojuli ngayinye yekhodi ye-QR ngamaphikseli (2-20px)
hints.normalizeNewlines: Guqula amafomethi e-newline ahlukene abe yifomethi evamile
hints.pixelSnap: Ungazihlwitha kanjani izindawo zemojuli emingceleni yamaphikseli
hints.qrVersion: Inguqulo yekhodi ye-QR (0=okuzenzakalelayo, 1-40 inyusa usayizi namandla)
hints.quietZone: Imajini yendawo ethule ezungeze ikhodi ye-QR (amamojula angu-0-10, anconyiwe: 4+)
hints.rsvpNote: Xhuma kwifomu le-RSVP eliku-inthanethi noma ikhasi lokubhalisa umcimbi
hints.safetyMode: Imodi yokuhlaziya ukuphepha - ukuhlola ngokuqinile ukufundeka kwekhodi ye-QR
hints.selectContentType: Khetha uhlobo lokuqukethwe ozobhala kukhodi ye-QR

hints.validateInput: Qinisekisa idatha yokufaka ngaphambi kokufaka ikhodi

welcome.title: Siyakwamukela ku-ANQR
welcome.subtitle: Professional QR Code Generator
welcome.intro: Dala amakhodi e-QR amangalisayo, angaskena anokumbondelana kwezithombe, ukugqwayiza, nesitayela esithuthukisiwe. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi udinga amakhodi alula amakhadi ebhizinisi noma amakhodi e-QR anopopayi anophawu lwezimpawu ezidijithali, i-ANQR ikukhavé.
welcome.feature1Desc: Izinguqulo ezilungiselelwe ngokuzenzakalelayo nokulungiswa kwamaphutha ukuze kuthwetshulwe okuthembekile
welcome.feature2Desc: Hlanganisa izithombe, amalogo, nama-GIF ngokuqondile kumakhodi akho e-QR
welcome.feature3Desc: Imibala, umumo, ama-gradient, nokwenza ngokwezifiso iphethini yesitholi
welcome.feature4Desc: Dala amakhodi e-QR ahehayo ezibonisi zedijithali
welcome.feature5Desc: Ukuhlola ukuthembeka kweskeni kwesikhathi sangempela kanye nokwenza kahle
welcome.feature6Desc: Khipha njenge-PNG, i-SVG, i-GIF, noma yabelana nge-URL nazo zonke izilungiselelo ezigciniwe
welcome.update1: Isigaba Esisha Sokufunda esinemihlahlandlela ejulile yokudayisa, izinkokhelo, nokuphrinta
welcome.update2: Izibonelo zomhlaba wangempela ezinezifundo zezenzakalo kanye nemikhuba ehamba phambili
welcome.update3: Izilimi ezingu-40+ manje zisekelwa ngokuhumusha okugcwele kwe-UI
welcome.update4: Ukuhlaziywa kokuphepha okuthuthukisiwe kanye nezindlela zokunqwabelanisa zokuqaphela i-ECC
welcome.step1: Faka okuqukethwe kwakho (i-URL, umbhalo, i-WiFi, i-vCard, njll.)
welcome.step2: Enza ngendlela oyifisayo imibala, isitayela, futhi ngokuzikhethela wengeze imbondela yesithombe
welcome.step3: Thumela ikhodi yakho ye-QR noma wabelane ngesixhumanisi sokumisa
welcome.footerNote: Lo mlayezo ngeke uphinde uvele kuze kube isibuyekezo esilandelayo.
